Do a sensitive preg test right b4 starting and use nonhormonal contraception during therapy: in utero exposure may cause androgenic effects on a female fetus.

Thromboembolic events, incl life-threatening or fatal CVAs, have been reported. Long-term use: peliosis hepatis and benign hepatic adenoma, which may be silent until a life-threatening intra-abd hemorrhage. Several cases of benign IC HTN (pseudotumor cerebri): w its Sx, screen for papilledema and stop danazol if present.
